sources.title: 2027 entry deadline for the universities of Oxford and Cambridge and most courses in medicine
sources.claim: Applications for 2027 entry to Oxford, Cambridge and most medicine, veterinary medicine/science and dentistry courses must reach UCAS by 18:00 UK time on 15 October 2026. Most other courses: 18:00 on 13 January 2027.

sources.title: When Is The UCAS Application Deadline? Preparing Students For 2027 Entry
sources.claim: Schools set earlier internal deadlines; the school must check the application, attach the reference and predicted grades, and send it before 18:00.

sources.title: Undergraduate Admissions Report 2026 (Table 1.1)
sources.claim: 2025 cycle: 23,329 applications, 3,891 offers, 3,302 admitted (offer rate 16.7%). 87.2% of admitted students were awarded A*AA or better at A-level.

sources.title: Plasmo – past papers, marked by AI
sources.claim: Real GCSE, A-level, AP, SAT and ACT papers marked straight away with written feedback.
